title: Editor canvas
what: The editor's canvas and the changes dragging makes: a handle on every anchor, a chosen node's handles, anchors and handles held on a tenth and inside the screen, smooth nodes kept on one line, and parts and nodes added or removed.

title: Part number fields
what: The chosen part's numbers beside the canvas: open or closed, its paints and line width, the chosen node's anchor and handles with smooth or corner, and the parts inside it, each box stepped by buttons laid out for the screen.

title: Face editor
what: The editor at /bmo-face/edit: its two tabs for a face's groups and the mouth stages, the canvas or the parts inside one, the toolbar's actions, and one save for the whole document.

title: Editor preview
what: The display drawing of what is being edited, beside the canvas, able to play the mouth stages on a loop as speaking would.
